description: This file defines the RemoveList class, a Java class implementing an entity operation for removing a list of GenericValue entities within the Apache OFBiz minilang framework. It handles the parsing of the 'remove-list' XML element and executes the removal logic via the Delegator.

classes.name: RemoveList
classes.description: A class representing the <remove-list> entity operation in OFBiz's minilang framework. It retrieves a list of entities from the environment and removes all of them using the delegator.

classes.name: RemoveListFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating instances of RemoveList from XML elements within the minilang framework.

methods.name: RemoveList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoveList operation by parsing attributes from the XML element, including the list accessor.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the remove-list operation by retrieving the entity list and removing all entities via the delegator.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the RemoveList instance.
